content.bridge_context: Building on basic shapes, this unit focuses on the fundamental elements of geometry: points, lines, and the space between them called angles.

units.title: Point and Line
units.explanation: A point shows a location; a line is a collection of points extending infinitely in both directions.
units.dual_language_instruction: Draw a dot and label it 'A'. Draw a straight path through it. / एक बिंदु बनाएं और उसे 'A' नाम दें। उससे होकर गुजरने वाला एक सीधा रास्ता बनाएं।

units.title: Meeting of Lines
units.explanation: When two lines meet at a point, they form an angle.
units.dual_language_instruction: Open a pair of scissors. Do you see the angle? / एक कैंची खोलें। क्या आप कोण देख पा रहे हैं?
